blocks.text: Tanzania’s Jihan Dimack claimed the coveted “golden crown,” emerging as the winner of Miss Grand International 2026 during the pageant’s grand final in Thailand on Saturday evening, Oct. 10. Dimack outshone 75 other candidates from across the globe to succeed Filipino beauty queen Emma Tiglao, who won the title last year. The coronation ceremony was […]...
